_comment: Order-layer and rules-based AI parameters. Not engine physics — these govern how orders (MoveOrder, MarkOrder, etc.) and the rules-based AI translate high-level intent into SpeedMode/direction requests. The neural network path bypasses all of these except where it issues orders explicitly.

movement._comment: Brake-to-turn and close-proximity brakes applied in _compute_movement_intent (order layer only — not used by the neural network direct-drive path).
movement._comment_brake_turn: Heading change above this triggers brake-to-turn: the order forces SpeedMode.STANDSTILL so the player decelerates before pivoting. 75=current, 90=original less aggressive.
movement._comment_brake_min: Brake-to-turn and close-prox checks only fire above this ground speed. Below it, turn rate is already high enough to pivot freely without braking.
movement._comment_close_prox: Lateral-overshoot brake: within close_prox_radius_m of target, if velocity cos-sim < threshold, force STANDSTILL. Prevents a player arriving at pace from the wrong angle blowing past and orbiting. cos 0.3 = ~73° off-axis.

repulsion._comment: Player-repulsion steering — used ONLY in steering.py / MoveOrder handling. NOT engine physics. radius_m: distance at which repulsion begins. strength_base: peak directional weight at d=0 (m/s-equivalent, blended into heading not force). ball_carrier_repulsion_mult: extra boost when the moving player has the ball. ball_carrier_speed_penalty_max: max fractional speed penalty for ball carriers (0.45 = 45% reduction). speed_penalty_scale: converts |net_repulsion| to speed penalty fraction. alignment_dot_threshold: trigger orthogonal nudge when rel_vel . net_repulsion < this (i.e. heading nearly straight into obstacle). min_orthogonal_adjust_mps: sideways nudge magnitude (primary tuning knob). max_deflection_deg: hard cap on total direction deflection from repulsion.

marking._comment: MarkOrder AI behaviour: marker stands between a target opposition player and the ball, and switches to GetPossession-style chase/tackle when the target has the ball or the ball comes within mark_intercept_radius_m. mark_standoff_m: distance from the target (toward the ball) the marker tries to hold.
